  "pros": [
    "Simple and intuitive interface for project communication.",
    "Centralized place for team collaboration and file sharing.",
    "Predictable flat-rate pricing is beneficial for a growing team."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Limited advanced features or customization options compared to competitors.",
    "Reporting capabilities might not be robust enough for detailed business development tracking.",
    "Lack of deep integrations with specialized animation tools."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This business development executive in the animation industry found Basecamp to be a straightforward and effective tool for basic project communication and team collaboration. While appreciating its ease of use and clear pricing, they likely felt its functionality and customization options were somewhat limited for more complex sales and project tracking needs, especially within a creative environment. Despite these limitations, it served as a solid central hub for their 11-50 person company."
